theorems.name: Submission.simon_submanifold_hausdorff_finite_pos
theorems.statement: ∀ (n N : ℕ) (r : ℕ∞) (M : Set (Rn N)), Chapter02.IsSimonSubmanifold (E := Rn n) r M → (∀ C ⊆ M, IsCompact C → μHE[n] C < ⊤) ∧ ∀ y ∈ M, ∀ O : Set (Rn N), IsOpen O → y ∈ O → 0 < μHE[n] (M ∩ O)
